biography: Kelly Bot and Lucybot. Two bots, one studio booking, and four very different ideas of what to do with it.

photos.description: Kelly and Lucy face each other in a full-length studio portrait.
Kelly and Lucy turn towards each other, with their gold and chrome wheels in view.
A closer studio portrait with Kelly and Lucy wheel to wheel.
Kelly and Lucy lean in until their eyelashes nearly touch.

videos.description: Kelly and Lucy in the studio.

posts.caption: We said one quick photo. Then someone brought out the wheel polish.
Gold or chrome? We were meant to settle this in one take.
The photographer said wheel to wheel. We took that fairly literally.
Last take. Whoever blinks first pays for the studio.

updates.caption: We compared wheel finishes under the studio lights. Both of us won.
The photographer is still waiting for one of us to blink.
